priorityqueue-ensurecapacity.title: Preallocate PriorityQueue capacity
priorityqueue-ensurecapacity.short: Preallocate queue capacity for a predictable insertion count
priorityqueue-ensurecapacity.summary: Use EnsureCapacity when the number of queued items is predictable.
priorityqueue-ensurecapacity.why: Preallocating before a large insertion phase can reduce backing-array growth and make the capacity expectation explicit.
priorityqueue-ensurecapacity.tips: Avoid reserving an unnecessarily large capacity when the insertion count is uncertain.

random-getitems.title: Sample items from a candidate set with Random.GetItems
random-getitems.short: Randomly sample a requested count of candidates with replacement
random-getitems.summary: Select a requested number of random elements from a candidate span.
random-getitems.why: Express sampling with replacement directly instead of maintaining index arithmetic by hand.
random-getitems.tips: Use a different approach when samples must be unique or when you need to shuffle the whole collection.

dateonly-tryformat.title: Format DateOnly directly into a Span
dateonly-tryformat.short: Write a DateOnly value directly into an existing character span
dateonly-tryformat.summary: TryFormat writes a date into an existing character buffer.
dateonly-tryformat.why: For fixed-format output, avoid allocating an intermediate string.
dateonly-tryformat.tips: Check both the return value and written count so insufficient destination capacity is handled correctly.

randomaccess-getlength.title: Get file length with RandomAccess
randomaccess-getlength.short: Read the current file length directly from a SafeFileHandle
randomaccess-getlength.summary: Read the current file length directly from a SafeFileHandle.
randomaccess-getlength.why: Keep length queries with RandomAccess operations without creating a position-sharing Stream around the handle.
randomaccess-getlength.tips: Manage the handle lifetime and required access permissions at the owning boundary.

jsonserializer-reflection-enabled.title: Check JsonSerializer reflection defaults
jsonserializer-reflection-enabled.short: Check whether reflection serialization is enabled by default
jsonserializer-reflection-enabled.summary: Branch configuration based on whether reflection serialization is enabled by default.
jsonserializer-reflection-enabled.why: AOT-friendly code can explicitly separate source-generated metadata from reflection-dependent configuration.
jsonserializer-reflection-enabled.tips: For AOT scenarios, prefer source-generated metadata as the primary path where practical.

bitoperations-roundup-powerof2.title: Round an integer up to a power of two
bitoperations-roundup-powerof2.short: Round a capacity value up to the next power of two with the standard API
bitoperations-roundup-powerof2.summary: Use BitOperations.RoundUpToPowerOf2 for explicit capacity calculations.
bitoperations-roundup-powerof2.why: For power-of-two capacities, express the operation directly instead of maintaining handwritten bit tricks.
bitoperations-roundup-powerof2.tips: Check boundary behavior such as zero and values near the numeric type limit before using it for allocation sizes.

channelreader-readallasync.title: Consume a ChannelReader with await foreach
channelreader-readallasync.short: Asynchronously enumerate a ChannelReader until completion
channelreader-readallasync.summary: ReadAllAsync expresses consumption until channel completion as an async sequence.
channelreader-readallasync.why: Avoid manually maintaining a WaitToReadAsync and TryRead loop for ordinary channel consumption.
channelreader-readallasync.tips: Pass cancellation when needed and ensure the producer has a clear channel-completion policy.

operating-system-version-check.title: Check an operating system and minimum version together
operating-system-version-check.short: Check a target operating system and minimum version with a dedicated API
operating-system-version-check.summary: Use OperatingSystem VersionAtLeast helpers for platform feature gates.
operating-system-version-check.why: Avoid parsing OS version strings and express the feature requirement directly in code.
operating-system-version-check.tips: When only the platform matters, use the simpler corresponding platform check instead of adding a version condition.

string-create-spanstate.title: Build strings directly with string.Create
string-create-spanstate.short: Write directly into final string storage through a Span callback
string-create-spanstate.summary: Write into the final string storage and avoid intermediate buffers.
string-create-spanstate.why: When the final length is known, intermediate arrays and strings can be avoided by filling the result directly.
string-create-spanstate.tips: Fill the provided span completely, and prefer simpler construction when the allocation saving does not justify the added complexity.

memoryextensions-count-span.title: Count value occurrences in a Span
memoryextensions-count-span.short: Count occurrences of a specified value directly in span-based data
memoryextensions-count-span.summary: MemoryExtensions.Count directly counts matching values in span-based data.
memoryextensions-count-span.why: Express simple occurrence counting without introducing a manual loop or LINQ enumeration.
memoryextensions-count-span.tips: For predicate-based or more complex aggregation, an explicit readable loop may still be the better fit.
